correctness.rationale: The covariance of cyclic characters on uniformly proper q-colourings is exactly (-1/(q-1))^{tree distance}, with unequal frequencies orthogonal by global colour translation. Bipartite depth gauge yields a positive tree exponential-distance Gram. Direct KQ multiplication proves the precision identity. An orthogonal complete radial/child-contrast decomposition yields one B_h and (b-1)b^ell copies of D_{h-ell}; their total dimension equals N. D_m is a trailing principal submatrix of B_h, so all extreme eigenvalues come from B_h. Explicit square-completion gives positivity and determinant 1-a^2. Gershgorin plus bulk test vectors prove the subcritical smallest and every-regime largest limits. Critical Robin boundary equation gives theta~pi/(2h), hence lambda_min~pi^2/(4h^2). Supercritical exact inverse trace together with rank-one eigenvalue separation proves lambda_min~u^{-h}/A, A=u(u-a^2)/((1-a^2)(u-1)^2). The executable package verify.py replayed PASS: 769 deterministic checks, including five exhaustive proper-colouring cases and exact fractional precision identities. All asymptotic conclusions are analytic; finite checks do not claim to prove infinity. The condition number is explicitly scoped to the nonconstant coordinates.

originality.rationale: Accessible primary text and actual semantic searches identify all three main precursor mechanisms (broadcast Kesten--Stigum threshold; tree exponential-distance/q-Laplacian inverse; homogeneous-tree adjacency child-contrast spectra), each explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The additional finite Fourier-coordinate Gram classification and sharp asymptotic constants across stable, critical, and unstable regimes were not obtained from the inspected sources, and neither known cycle nor bipartite proper-colouring Fourier results implies the tree case by specialisation. residual_risks: The original 2006 Bapat--Lal--Pati article body was unavailable, so only the abstract and its explicitly quoted lemmas were assessed.
Generalized Bethe-tree Jacobi spectra and broadcasting covariance literature might contain the same sharp asymptotic coefficients under different language; accessible comparisons are not exhaustive.
Semantic search lacks a completeness guarantee, and an unseen stronger theorem could imply the present result without identical titles or parameters.

value.rationale: The object is the natural first Fourier coordinate reconstruction system for uniformly proper q-colourings of a finite regular tree. Exact Riesz bounds control stability for recovering arbitrary linear single-site observables. A complete all-depth spectral classification gives quantifiable finite interpolation losses. The sharp transition from bounded conditioning to quadratic critical and exponential supercritical loss is structurally motivated by the broadcast branching factor and comes with previously unaccounted explicit leading coefficients. Unlike a routine tree inverse or an arbitrary finite size, this addresses a natural all-parameter stability question.
